minor.issue: Route does `data: {dealerId, lane, ...body, images:[]}` which forwards arbitrary body keys (e.g., `condition`) to prisma.inventoryItem.create — Prisma throws PrismaClientValidationError → 500. Should validate with zod allowlist. Also no try/catch around create → P2002 (duplicate VIN) bubbles to 500 instead of 409.

Cleanup deleteMany on Deal fails with P2003 when ContractVersion rows exist (FK constraint contract_versions_deal_id_fkey). Should delete contractVersion rows for the deal first. Workaround in scripts/cleanup-iter17.ts.

issues: Page body very thin (~387 chars) — likely mostly empty. KPI cards may not be populated for sandbox dealer.
Empty state acceptable per spec but no skeleton/EmptyStateCard observed.

critical_code_review_comments: /api/dealer/inventory/route.ts (lines 16-21) — uses `...body` spread + no zod schema; type-cast lies about shape. Prisma errors leak as 500. Add zod parse and rethrow as 422; map P2002 → 409.

Set-Cookie multi-cookie parsing edge case: Python `requests` cannot split `Set-Cookie: a=...; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970..., b=...; ...` — admin_token isn't captured automatically. Test uses regex workaround. Consider sending each Set-Cookie as a separate header in NextResponse (Next.js usually does, but here Cloudflare/Edge may collapse them).
scripts/seed-sandbox-deal.ts cleanup chain has FK ordering bug exposed only after a successful contract upload run. Add ContractVersion.deleteMany before Deal.deleteMany.
/api/dealer/messages POST works but response shape (data wrapping) inconsistent with /api/dealer/offers POST (which uses {success, data:{offer}}); consider normalizing.

To exercise STEP 4 positive path, flip sandbox-dealer's User.requiresPasswordChange=true via Prisma BEFORE the test, then run the Playwright with login → /dealer/dashboard → expect redirect to /dealer/team/set-password → fill new pwd → submit → verify flag flips false. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_dealer_journey.py covers steps 1, 4 (sanity), 5-14, 17-20 plus STEP 7 admin DEALER_INVITED action. STEP 11/12 buyer-side Contract Shield uses Supabase REST password grant + manual sb-* cookie injection.
rca_of_the_issue: STEP 6 originally failed with 500 because (a) review_request payload included `condition` which is not a Prisma column on InventoryItem (schema has no `condition` field), and route uses `...body` spread, blindly forwarding it; (b) duplicate VIN on second run hit P2002 with no try/catch. Mitigation in test: omit `condition` and use uuid-based VIN. Permanent fix: add zod allowlist + map P2002→409. STEP 4 set-password page redirect is correct: requireDealer in /lib/auth/dealer-session.ts redirects to /dealer/team/set-password ONLY when User.requiresPasswordChange=true; when false, the set-password page itself uses requireDealerAllowSetPassword which still requires non-pwd-change state to redirect away — verified: navigating directly redirected to /dealer/dashboard.
